conditions: Terms §8.2 explicitly prohibits resale/redistribution/sublicensing of API access without explicit written consent; reseller guide/manual approval is not proof that Vrooli has consent or an executed agreement.

Resolve Terms §4.1's stated Claude service scope against the reseller guide's Claude plus Codex/OpenAI-compatible groups and models docs that list GPT IDs. Limit any future rule to explicitly named model groups/routes in signed current terms.

For Claude, Terms §4.5 identifies Anthropic API as upstream; independently verify downstream rights, actual serving route, provider policy and per-model access. For Codex/GPT, actual provider/supplier and terms are not established by the reseller guide or model IDs.

Guide describes entry as an application plus $90 one-time purchase adding $1,000 personal API balance; it is not a reseller wholesale rate and is separate from the funded reseller wallet. Do not purchase or treat pack/catalog prices as Vrooli quote.

Verify key-specific model availability using the official model endpoint only after separately authorized access; public docs say aliases can change and availability is key-group scoped. Review data/privacy, customer disclosures, responsibilities and current uptime/limits.
No route is eligible until explicit written consent, actual reseller approval, exact agreement, and separate human approval of rule, models, trust and Vrooli price.
plan_rules.clause: Terms §§4.1–4.5 and 8.2; official reseller guide, manual approval and separate wallet/key groups
plan_rules.reason: Official reseller guide describes downstream customer keys, a management API and bundled SaaS use, but Terms require explicit written consent. Terms and reseller documentation conflict on Claude-only versus Codex/OpenAI model scope; therefore this is a conditional proposal only.

source_anchors.anchor: Terms §§4.1–4.5 and 8.2; official reseller guide, manual approval and separate wallet/key groups
source_anchors.supports: Terms §8.2 requires explicit written consent for resale/redistribution; body/header date representations conflict and described service/model scope is narrower than some reseller-guide claims.
source_anchors.does_not_establish: This source does not establish executed supplier approval or agreement, the exact Vrooli account entitlement, actual upstream serving provider/model rights, a live route, customer trust terms, or a human-approved price.

research.model_reason: Terms name Anthropic as upstream for Claude; reseller/docs mention Codex/GPT as well, whose actual serving source and contract coverage are unresolved. IDs/catalog rows do not prove entitlement.
